messages:
Morgan: Quick check-in — running a targeted admin scrub this week across KMS, GCP IAM, and our console admins. Goal: remove stale console admins and validate KMS key ACLs. Will start 11:30 UTC.
Priya: Thanks — can you post the checklist? I want to sync with the Dedicated infra team.
Morgan: Sure — high level: 1) export current IAM admins, 2) compare against last 90d activity, 3) confirm any service accounts with admin role, 4) open PRs to remove stale users, 5) run audit log query for any denied KMS ops.
Alex: pinging the KMS owner list — do we have a safe rollback plan if a key owner is removed and breaks a pipeline? :thinking_face:
Jin: Good call. Rollback plan: keep a 48h grace where we only disable (not delete) roles, annotate change with jira id, and notify app owners via #oncall-watch. If something breaks, re-add within 48h + postmortem.
Morgan: Example commands I'm using to export admins: 
```
gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod --format=json > prod_iam.json
jq '.bindings[] | select(.role|test("roles/owner|roles/editor|roles/iam.admin"))' prod_iam.json
```
Carla: For KMS, suggest we run this query against Stackdriver logs to surface denied/unauthorized calls in the last 7d:
```
resource.type="k8s_cluster" AND protoPayload.status.code=7 AND protoPayload.methodName:("Encrypt" OR "Decrypt" OR "AsymmetricSign")
```
Priya: Also add a step to validate CMK rotation settings and key versioning. We recently onboarded a new HSM integration — want to make sure no one lost access.
Alex: Who's owning the HSM/KMS entitlement list? I can scrub console users but not HSM module-level perms.
Morgan: @Jin can you own the HSM entitlement verification? I'll own console and IAM. Jin: yep.
Jin: I'll pull the KMS IAM bindings and cross-check with our humio logs. If I see any critical services using a high-priv SA, I'll tag it and propose a scoped role.
Carla: FYI deploy-bot just posted a policy update in #eng-infra — we should make sure our removal PRs follow the new patch template.
deploy-bot: New patch template v2 applied to repo:infra. See https://git.redwood/repo/infra/pulls for PR checklist.
Priya: For audit logging, do we have retention queries to show last 12 months of admin role grants? Need that for compliance.
Alex: I can generate a retention export, but might need elevated read to the audit bucket. Morgan: authorize Alex for a 2-hour read window — log the change and revoke after.
Morgan: I'm scheduling a 30min sync at 12:00 UTC to review findings and approve PRs. Will post the spreadsheet and attach PRs to the jira: RINF-723.
Jin: Also flag any service accounts with long-lived keys — we should rotate or replace with workload identity.
Carla: Quick note — don't remove any user who's part of an active on-call rotation until we notify them and the oncall lead.
Priya: Understood. I'll coordinate notifications.
Alex: I'll start the IAM export now and push prod_iam.json to the shared drive at /security/admin-scrub/1770034567/.
Morgan: Thanks team. If anyone finds a suspicious entitlement (unexpected admin granted outside SCIM), call it out here immediately. :rotating_light:
Priya: Will do.
Morgan: Closing loop — after the 48h grace, we'll create the cleanup PRs and ship them with a canary removal policy enabled (remove -> monitor -> finalize).
Carla: ack.
Alex: pushed the export and added a short script to diff current vs last-90d activity. Script snippet: `python scripts/iam_diff.py prod_iam.json baseline_90d.json`
Jin: I'll start KMS binding diff now and share any anomalies.
Morgan: Perfect — last reminder to tag all changes with RINF-723.
Priya: Thanks, see you at 12:00 UTC.
